Company Description
At DO & CO, where we specialize in creating exceptional catering experiences for iconic sporting events like the FIFA World Cup, UEFA Championship, and Formula One Grand Prix. With a career at DO & CO, you'll be right in the thick of the action, working behind the scenes to make sure every detail of the event is perfect. From creating gourmet menus to ensuring seamless service, you'll be an essential part of the team that makes these events truly unforgettable. 1 Head Chef - Chinese Cuisine Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Head Chef specializing in Chinese Cuisine to join our team in Vienna. Our production kitchen serves high-end airline clients, and we are looking for someone with relevant experience in cooking Indian cuisine in similar operations. 

In this role, you'll be responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the Chinese cuisine section in our production kitchen. You'll supervise and lead a team of chefs, while also training and mentoring them in Indian cuisine techniques, ingredients, and cooking methods. 

Your keen eye for detail and dedication to excellence will ensure that food preparation and presentation adhere to both company and industry standards. With your leadership skills, you'll be able to manage inventory and purchasing of Indian cuisine ingredients, equipment, and supplies. 

 * Lead and manage a team of kitchen staff to ensure that all dishes are prepared to the highest standards of quality and consistency 

 * Manage stock and ordering supplies, including authentic Indian ingredients, ensuring that all products are fresh and of the highest quality 

 * Continually review and improve processes to ensure maximum efficiency and quality of output 

 * Ensuring the timely delivery of food, while maintaining the highest levels of quality and consistency 

 * Managing and training a team of skilled chefs and kitchen staff 

 * Maintaining a clean and organized kitchen environment 

 * Maintaining the highest levels of food safety and sanitation standards 

 * Travel to international events (Formula 1, UEFA Champions League Final, ATP Madrid, etc.) 

Qualifications

 * Minimum of 5 years' experience in high-end operations cooking Indian cuisine 

 * In-depth knowledge of Chinese ingredients, techniques, and flavours 

 * Experience in managing a team of kitchen staff 

 * Ability to create and develop menus that showcase both traditional and innovative Chinese cuisine 

 * Excellent communication in English - Chinese is a plus 

 * Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment 

Additional Information

We believe that our employees are the driving force behind our success and strive to create a positive and supportive work environment. As a member of our team, you will have access to a range of benefits, including:

 * A monthly salary starting at €4,500 gross with the willingness to overpay with appropriate experience and qualifications 

 * A wonderful workplace to call home, events, fun colleagues, and all other regular salary/benefits

 * A business where you can have a real impact - we're not afraid of new ideas!

 * Genuine career development opportunities, both nationally and internationally

 * The opportunity to work with and represent one of the most innovative players in the luxury global gourmet entertainment market

DO & CO is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status

ANDRITZ Pumps is a leading manufacturer of centrifugal pumps with a broad, competitive product and application portfolio and global manufacturing and sales presence. Our main manufacturing locations are found in Austria, China, India, and Brazil. We develop, manufacture, and distribute pumps that are engineered and built for a single project as well as standard pumps that are based on a modular system. 

To fulfil our demanding delivery time goals for the European and African Market, we carry a significant stock of parts in Graz, that are used both for Service and Assembly of new Pumps.

In our Pumps Division in Graz, we are looking for 1 Senior MRP Controller & Inventory Manager (m/f/d) You will be responsible for operative stock management and stock management strategy for centrifugal pumps as well as active management of net working capital.

Your Tasks

You will be responsible for the entire material planning process and material availability. As part of ongoing demand planning, you review the demand and inventory status of the planned materials, make any necessary adjustments, and ensure the availability of materials for the production process.

 * Responsibility for maintaining the material master data (MRP) relevant for scheduling and planning requisitions to ensure optimal supply for assembly

 * Interface with purchasing, plant, quality department, internal production facilities, suppliers, etc.

 * Creating and releasing requirements

 * Creating planning and releasing order requisitions 

 * Check material availability in the course of scheduling 

 * Model management for casting models 

 * Continuous monitoring of inventory turnover time and active management of stock value based on the monitoring 

Are You Our Ideal Candidate?

 * Completed commercial or technical training (HAS, HAK, HTL), university degree advantageous.

 * Professional Background in requisition planning and execution essential. This includes especially the theory, practical application and handling in IT Systems of:

 ** SAP operative expert user

 ** ABC XYZ Analysis

 ** Disposition Parameters including Safety Stock, Reorder Point, Optimal Reorder Quantity

 ** Understanding of complex bill of materials with multi-level structure and variances

 * Knowledge of pumps and the pump industry would be preferred, or of comparable products

 * Enthusiasm for technical contexts

 * Proficient MS Office skills (especially MS Excel)

 * Languages: proficient German and English

 * Strong teamwork and (intercultural) communication skills

Our offer

 * An interesting position in an established corporate environment with the opportunity to actively shape your professional future

 * A great group of highly professional colleagues and management

 * Talent & leadership programs

 * Various employee discounts

 * Subsidized company restaurant
